jobs.description: NioTerra | Controlled Environment Agriculture | Skip to content Skip to content IoT aesense NioTerra Services Industries About Us Careers Contact Us Main Menu IoT aesense NioTerra Services Industries About Us Careers Contact Us Grow Anywhere Controlled Environment Agriculture for the Next Generation of Food, Pharma and Sustainable Production NioTerra is AES’s proprietary Controlled Environment Agriculture platform, designed to grow premium crops in closed, modular, data-driven environments – anywhere, anytime, with exceptional consistency, resource efficiency and full traceability. Powered by AES’s expertise in sensing, IoT, embedded systems, AI-driven analytics and full-stack engineering. Grow Anywhere NioTerra enables controlled production in locations and markets where traditional agriculture is limited, unstable or economically inefficient with CO2 Negative footprint. Local food security Pharma-grade crop production Urban and indoor production Off-grid and harsh-environment agriculture Education and social-impact programs An Environment Within an Environment NioTerra is built around AES’s “Environment Within an Environment” concept. Instead of controlling an entire facility as one large growing space, the platform uses independent growing modules, each with precise control over air, water, lighting, fertilization and environmental parameters. Modular growing system Closed-loop resource cycles Industrial traceability from protocol to harvest Growing diverse crops in parallel Above organic, zero pesticides NioTerra Technology NioTerra combines smart growing modules, sensors and actuators, closed-loop air and water systems, dedicated lighting, IoT control and AI-driven analytics into one controlled production platform. Each growing cell continuously measures and adjusts crop conditions by cultivar, growth stage and operational target — enabling repeatable, traceable and optimized production. Up to hundreds of sensors and actuators Manage by a single innovative controller Dedicated efficient lighting IoT + edge/cloud processing Real-time growth optimization One Platform. Multiple Crop Categories. Multiple Markets. NioTerra is designed to support a wide range of high-value agricultural and biotechnological applications – from premium fresh produce to pharma-grade cultivation and advanced biological production. jobs.description: A wide range of industry applications IoT solution | AES Skip to content Skip to content IoT aesense NioTerra Services Industries About Us Careers Contact Us Main Menu IoT aesense NioTerra Services Industries About Us Careers Contact Us Industries With a wide range of industry applications, our full-stack, integrated IoT solution enables you to quickly increase efficiency, increase capacity and improve the quality you deliver to your customers Agriculture / Digital Farming The Internet of Things is transforming the agriculture sector as we know it today by providing farmers with innovative smart farming solutions that help improve the efficiency of their everyday work. Utilization of sensors to cloud platform enables smarter, faster, and more accurate irrigation and fertigation of crops with digital farming solutions. Farmers can now easily monitor, analyze, and automate their irrigation from wherever they are, ensuring the most precise irrigation and fertigation. With full visibility of environmental conditions enabled by sensor data and analytics, farmers can now monitor all soil, weather, crop, environmental, and hydraulic conditions by receiving real-time updates on their field conditions. Our platform enables full control of yield optimization while increasing productivity and saving valuable resources. Utilities/ Smart Metering IoT solutions for smarter energy consumption and management is revolutionizing how utility companies are managing their assets, helping them address challenges surrounding energy consumption and usage (electricity, gas and water). Our IoT sensor to cloud platform for Smart Metering applications, enables utility companies to more effectively plan and manage energy distribution, improve asset utilization, capacity planning and reduce overall downtime. By providing remote continuous measurement and diagnostics of energy consumption, enable optimal consumption management, load reduction during maximum consumption times, availability of consumer usage information, real-time detection of problems and alerting capabilities, all aimed at optimizing operational costs and making sure consumers stay safe. Industrial / Smart Tools The Industrial Internet of Things (IoT) is transforming traditional manufacturing as we know it today. While factory uptime is critical for successful operation, it is important to monitor different parameters at the product line, machine, and tool level to ensure that the performance of your assets is maintained. Not only can connected assets improve operational efficiencies, they can also provide actionable insights for machine and tool manufacturers regarding the performance of their products anywhere in the world. AES Aesense advanced AI and algorithms backed with high Precision Sensing capabilities, reveal real value-added possibilities in the form of Smarter Analysis and Automated Decision-making between connected industrial assets. Our ability to detect & analyze even the smallest signals in noisy environments enables more accurate, sensitive, and differentiated data, critical for accurate and immediate decision-making and Predictive Maintenance capabilities, allowing you to monitor machine health and plan maintenance before failures actually occur. Healthcare / Wearables Working with worldwide healthcare and wearable device manufacturers, AES is making it possible to connect individuals and devices to enable better visibility into health diagnostics data and produce actionable insights that improve people’s health and well-being. One of the greatest benefits of IoT-enabled wearable healthcare devices is that they provide individuals with the information they need to gain better control over their health and fitness outcomes allowing more informed decisions to be made. As many of these devices are wearable and carried by individuals throughout the day, it is critical to remove the barriers of size and weight to enable smaller, more responsive technology compatible with this task. AES technologies implementation like miniaturization, sensors, and algorithms offer the perfect solution for wearable technology connectivity by providing advanced processing capabilities with the smallest footprint to enable smaller, more responsive, low-power performance within size. AES is dedicated to helping companies successfully connect physical devices to the digital world by reducing the complexity involved in developing and deploying IoT applications and using AI to create valued technical and business insights. Founded in 2012, AES delivers a market-ready, end-to-end IoT (Internet of Things) platform for connecting commercial and industrial IoT applications & devices, designed to help companies successfully connect physical devices to the digital world for purposes of saving time and resources, optimizing operations, improving services and increasing productivity. With proven industry experience in various market segments, AES offers all of the building blocks – hardware, software, and connectivity expertise for creating a comprehensive IoT & AI solution. Our solutions serve as the foundation and core technology for enabling seamless, sensor-to-cloud IoT connectivity incorporating AI capabilities for various industry applications and for virtually any number of devices. Since IoT is in our DNA, we enjoy putting our minds together to deliver innovative solutions at the highest standards and cutting-edge technology. From Industrial to commercial IoT applications, AES has designed some of the most unique implementations for connecting devices that deliver new value to both business and consumers. jobs.description: Accessibility | Skip to content Skip to content IoT aesense NioTerra Services Industries About Us Careers Contact Us Main Menu IoT aesense NioTerra Services Industries About Us Careers Contact Us Accessibilty Introduction Internet arena has a platform for expression and self-representation, it serves us as an arena for social and political. We buy and sell, through which employees are exposed now than before. As such, there is an obligation to allow the public an enjoyable browsing experience and easy as possible. We have devoted considerable resources to make this site accessible to allow the browsing experience for the entire population and people with disabilities in particular. The motto leads us is human dignity and freedom, since it is a cornerstone of Israeli society that we all have equal rights and are essentially equal. Using the accessibility component: This website incorporates a plugin that helps make the website accessible to people with disabilities. User Guide Menu: Welcome to the accessibility toolbar. Accessibility Plugin Key Features: Accessibility Widget: The core of Ally is its customizable widget that provides users with options to improve their browsing experience. Text Resizing: Visitors can increase the text size on the website. Line Height Adjustment: Users can increase the line height for better readability. Font Choice: The plugin allows users to switch to a more readable font. Contrast Controls: Users can adjust the contrast between text and background, including options for negative, high, light, or dark. Page Structure Display: This feature provides a structured list of headings and links, aiding navigation, especially for screen reader users. Reading Mask: A reading mask feature can be enabled to help users focus on specific parts of the content. Image Hiding: Visitors can choose to hide images to reduce distractions. How to use the plugin: To open it, click the round accessibility icon in the corner of your screen. No page reload is needed—just adjust the controls live and find the combination that makes reading and navigation easiest for you. • Text Size – Tap the “A+” or “A–” buttons to enlarge or shrink all on-page text. • Line Height – Increase spacing between lines for clearer reading. • Text Align – Switch text alignment to left, right or center to suit your preference. • Readable Font – Swap to a dyslexia-friendly typeface for improved letter shape recognition. • Contrast Modes – Slide between Negative, High, Light and Dark contrast or apply Grayscale to reduce color complexity. • Sitemap (Page Structure) – View a structured list of headings, landmarks and links for easier screen-reader navigation. • Reading Guide – Overlay a movable ruler or mask to help track your place line by line. • Hide Images – Remove all images to minimize distractions or speed up page load. • Pause Animations – Stop any moving elements that might draw your attention away from text. • Focus Outline – Highlight the currently focused element—ideal for keyboard or switch-device users. • Links Underline – Turn on underlines for every hyperlink so you can spot links at a glance. • Restore Defaults – Click “Reset” to clear your settings and return the site to its original look. If you prefer keyboard controls, press Tab (or Shift + Tab) to cycle through toolbar buttons, Enter or Space to activate a feature, Esc to close the toolbar, and the arrow keys to fine-tune sliders and lists once the panel is open. Enjoy a browsing experience tailored to your needs! Accessibility Details at Ameral Offices: Yokneam, HaTamar 3 4 disabled parking spaces in the building’s parking lot . Accessible elevators . There is an accessible route from the building’s parking lot to the company’s offices . On every floor at the secretarial area, there is an accessible reception desk with an accessible service counter . Accessible restrooms are available on the first floor in the company’s service areas . Identification and directional signs are provided on every floor of the building . Service animals that assist individuals with disabilities are permitted entry into the building and the company’s offices . Tel Aviv, Karlibach 10 Disabled parking spaces in the TLV Mall parking lot . The building’s elevators are not wheelchair accessible . There is an accessible route from the building’s parking lot to the building’s elevators . At the secretarial area, there is an accessible reception desk that includes an accessible service counter . Service animals that assist individuals with disabilities are permitted entry into the building and the company’s offices . For the avoidance of doubt: We are committed to make our site accessible to all people with abilities and with disabilities. This site have the technology that suits your needs. This site is a largely usable for the entire population We’re making every effort You may find elements that are not Fully accessible, that has not been accessible to or maybe we have not found suitable technology and alongside this we ensure that maximum efforts are made to improve and make accessible high level and without compromises. If you have any difficulty browsing the site and watching us, we apologize and would be very pleased that you turn your attention to this.
